timing: 30-minute halves. The first half ran 31 minutes and the second half ran 32 minutes. Minutes in this report are as logged in RefSix, which uses a running clock and started the second half at 34'.

reports.title: Incident 1: Send-off, Hilltop SC #7
subject: Player:
#7 Jordan Example, Hilltop SC G2014
Misconduct:
Caution UB (20'), Caution UB (51'), Sent off for second caution (51')

sections.label: 20th minute:
sections.text: Near the halfway line, Hilltop SC #7 pulled a Riverside FC attacker to the ground by the shirt, stopping a promising attack. I cautioned #7 for unsporting behavior. Play restarted with a direct free kick to Riverside FC at the location of the foul.

sections.label: 51st minute:
sections.text: In the middle third, assistant referee Sam Chen signaled a foul by Hilltop SC #7. My view of the challenge was blocked by two players. I stopped play and consulted with the AR, who reported that #7 tackled a Riverside FC player from behind with studs raised after the ball had been played away. I cautioned #7 for unsporting behavior (reckless foul). This was her second caution of the match, so I showed the red card and sent her off. Play restarted with a direct free kick to Riverside FC at the location of the foul.
